summary: Ruben Abrica supported a ceasefire resolution in East Palo Alto in April 2024 and, per CAM's report, voted against the city council's resolution endorsing the IHRA definition of antisemitism. CAIR Action endorsed his general-election campaign and Vote for Peace rated him an Ally. His personal legislative actions on ceasefire support and IHRA opposition, combined with those pro-Palestine endorsements, mark him as a concrete local champion for Palestinian justice.
